sentences.en: Some of the tariffs were as high as sixty percent.
sentences.zh: 有些关税高达百分之六十。

sentences.en: High tariffs have become a barrier to international trade.
sentences.zh: 高关税已经成为国际贸易的障碍。

sentences.en: High tariffs are the chief obstacles to free trade.
sentences.zh: 高关税是自由贸易的主要障碍。
